integrity: The all-index family has a symbolic four-residue proof. The finite census is certified by factor-language closure and exhaustive reproducible code; its small-range checks are cross-checks rather than substitutes for proof.
scientific_limitations: The all-shift set of four-pseudoperiods is not classified. The exact enumeration applies only to maximum shift 64; the arithmetic family holds at every positive integer parameter.
title: Infinite four-pseudoperiod family and shift-64 census for the Rudin–Shapiro word
